# Challenge 5: Delivery Mission

The supplied mission sequence combines stationary range estimation, one named
map change, grid planning, and the prior navigation work. Continue with the
completed components from Challenge 4, add `SensorModel.estimate_range`, and
select each tested student component with its named flag in `course_setup.py`.
With every flag left `False`, the complete mission runs with supplied
components so sensing, planning, and integration can be inspected first.
